title: Run in with black suits
content: A woman in a black suit with white hair in a pixie cut told me to take out my phone and choose a color between red and blue. I chose a pretty dark purple. She said lighter in color. She told me to make a contract with that color in my phone. Then she had me set the contract image. It was like an AI image of a purple forest on a metallic mountain. There was a barcode on the image. She scanned it for a long time. There was no beep. I started to get worried about it when I noticed a man watching from my right. Older and bald similar black suit. The woman started to talk in a cryptic way. Like a riddle. The man repeated some of it and added some to it. The man stood and whispered into the woman's ear. They left together and came back. In unison they said next and I woke up. Did I just get an ID? Or tagged? Or put on some kind of list?
